amountChanged: The amount is now {{amount}}. Check it and pay again.
autoRenewNote: {{amount}} is taken on {{date}} if the balance covers it.
blAwaitingLead: No payment was submitted for this request. Pay within {{hours}} hours or it lapses; nothing is charged.
blCancelledLead: You cancelled this payment, or started a new one in its place. Nothing was charged.
blCheckingLead: Lytro support is matching the payment, usually within an hour. Nothing changes before it is confirmed; we will tell you when it is.
blEmpty: Your payments to Lytro and their invoices appear here. The first comes with a plan or a top-up.
blExpiredLead: No payment arrived within 24 hours, so the request lapsed. Nothing was charged. Start again when you like.
blForTopUp: {{amount}} to be added to the balance
blNotRecent: This payment is not among your recent ones.
blRejectedLead: Nothing was activated by this payment; the plan and the balance are as they were. Read the note from support and pay again, or write to support.
blTlExpired: No payment within 24 hours · request lapsed
cnBanner: The subscription ends on {{date}}. Then grace, then the shop closes.
cnStep2: After day {{day}}: view only, nothing can change
cnStep3: After day {{day}}: locked; only the owner can renew or export
cnStep4: After day {{day}}: the shop data is deleted; balance and invoices stay
cnTitle: Stop the subscription at period end?
cnUndo: You can undo any time before {{date}}.
csCons1: Now: storefront, payment page and API go offline; staff cannot sign in.
csCons2: After 60 days: products, orders, customers and photos are deleted. The balance, invoices and your account stay.
csCons3: Buying a plan or taking pay-as-you-go again before then brings everything back as it was.
dcLead: On {{plan}} since {{date}}. What is over the limit stays visible and sells; nothing new is added. A final warning goes out unless it is settled by {{end}}.
dgNote1: Existing products keep selling; adding new ones is blocked until the count fits.
dgNote2: You choose who stays active; nobody is deleted.
dgOver: These will be over the limit
dgWhen: On {{date}}, at period end. Nothing changes or is charged before that.
dsBanner_one: Moving from {{from}} to {{to}} on {{date}} · {{count}} will be over the limit
dsBanner_other: Moving from {{from}} to {{to}} on {{date}} · {{count}} will be over the limit
frozenNote: The balance is frozen while the shop is closed. It opens with a plan.
pgFees: No monthly fee. {{min}} or {{pct}}% per order when it ships or is booked, whichever is more; {{product}} per new product; all from the balance.
pgOverNote: Products over the limit keep selling; adding new ones is blocked. One seat: you choose who stays.
pgWhen: On {{date}}, at period end. Nothing changes before that, and nothing is refunded.
pkAutoBw: Buy a {{size}} pack when bandwidth reaches 100%
pkAutoReq: Buy a {{size}} pack when requests reach 100%
plPendingNow: {{amount}} payment is being checked. Nothing changes until it is confirmed.
plRejected: {{amount}} payment was rejected: "{{note}}" The plan has not changed.
plUpgraded: {{plan}} is on · new period runs until {{date}}
psBalanceLow: Not enough; top up or pay by {{wallets}}
psNote: Nothing changes before it is confirmed. The period extends when it matches; the request lapses if no payment arrives within 24 hours.
pyCloseNote: Pay-as-you-go has no period, so closing archives the shop at once: storefront and API go offline, data is deleted after 60 days. Only the owner can.
pyFeeBalance: Fees come from the balance; a low balance never blocks taking an order, only shipping it until you top up.
quoteValid: This quote holds for 15 minutes. A started period is not refunded.
renewNote_one: The plan ended {{count}} day ago. Renewing reopens everything within a minute. Your data is intact.
renewNote_other: The plan ended {{count}} days ago. Renewing reopens everything within a minute. Your data is intact.
renewNoteArchived_one: The plan ended {{count}} day ago. Your data is kept until {{date}}; renew before then and everything reopens within a minute.
renewNoteArchived_other: The plan ended {{count}} days ago. Your data is kept until {{date}}; renew before then and everything reopens within a minute.
renewNoteClosed: The shop is closed. Your data is kept until {{date}}; take a plan or pay-as-you-go before then and everything reopens within a minute.

row.carry_over: Carried over from your earlier shop

sentForCheck: The payment is sent for checking. We will tell you when it is confirmed; until then nothing changes.
startsNow: Starts on confirmation; a fresh 30-day period.
startsNowTerm: Starts on confirmation; a fresh period of {{term}}.
stopNote: At period end the shop enters grace, is view-only after {{viewOnly}} days and its data is deleted at day {{deleted}}. Undo any time before.
tuNoteWallet: Next you send it by {{wallets}}; it is added when it matches.
tuPending: {{amount}} top-up is being checked. It is added when it matches, usually within an hour. We will tell you.
tuRejected: {{amount}} top-up was rejected: "{{note}}" Nothing was added to the balance.
uAbCapped: Auto-buy has bought its {{cap}} packs this cycle; it buys no more before {{date}}.
uAbFailed: Auto-buy couldn’t buy a pack: the balance was too short.
uAbFailedShort: Couldn’t buy: the balance was too short
uAutoBuyHelp: From the balance; it stops when the balance runs out. Service continues to 110% free while the notice goes out.
uFullProducts: Products are full: {{used}} of {{limit}}. New products can’t be added; the ones you have stay listed and sell.
uFullSeats: Seats are full: {{used}} of {{limit}}. No one can be added or brought back until there is room.
uFullSms: Free SMS used: {{used}} of {{limit}} this month. Further essential SMS cost {{amount}} each from the balance.
uFullSmsNoRate: Free SMS used: {{used}} of {{limit}} this month. Further essential SMS are paid from the balance.
uFullSmsTrial: Free SMS used: {{used}} of {{limit}}. Further essential SMS wait until you pick a plan; sign-in codes still go.
uFullStorage: Storage is full: {{used}} of {{limit}}. New photos and videos can’t be uploaded; the ones you have still show.
uMailedSms: An email and a free SMS went too.
unavTitle: Your shop is not available right now
undone: Undone · the plan runs on as before
uPaceLasts: At this pace the allowance lasts until the cycle ends on {{end}}.
uPaceOut: At this pace the allowance runs out on {{date}}; the cycle ends {{end}}.
uStoppedReq: Catalogue API stopped: {{used}} of {{limit}}. The notice went at 100%, it answered up to {{percent}}%, now your website and storefront get no catalogue. The extra is never charged.
uUsedUpBw: Bandwidth used up: {{used}} of {{limit}}. Images and videos keep showing up to {{stop}}, then stop until the cycle ends on {{end}}, unless there is more room. The extra is never charged.
uUsedUpReq: API requests used up: {{used}} of {{limit}}. The catalogue keeps answering up to {{stop}}, then stops until the cycle ends on {{end}}, unless there is more room. The extra is never charged.
wLowBal: Balance is {{amount}}. Below {{floor}}, SMS and chat AI may stop.
wStopped: Images stopped: {{used}} of {{limit}}. The notice went at 100%, serving ran to {{percent}}%, now the storefront shows placeholders. The extra is never charged.
